subject: Quick math: Premium costs less than one beer
body_paragraphs: Keeping this short. Predictify Premium is the price of one beer per month at most bars. Or two coffees. Or half a Netflix subscription.

What you get for that: every high-confidence AI pick (the >85% ones, Premium-only), the full tactical analysis layer, custom alerts on your favorite teams, and zero ads. The annual plan works out to less than one coffee per month — most serious users go straight to annual after they realize how much they're using the app.

Most users who upgrade tell me they wish they'd done it sooner. The free version is great for casual fans. If you've been using the app for 3+ weeks, you're not casual — you're a real fan. The math just makes sense.
One tap below to upgrade. P.S. Annual saves a meaningful chunk vs paying monthly. If you're going to use the app for the rest of the season, annual is the obvious pick.
